options: The systematic analysis of data or statistics to uncover meaningful patterns, insights and trends
The physical storage of data on servers
The process of writing software applications
The manual entry of data into spreadsheets
The encryption of data before transmission
questions.explanation: Analytics is the systematic analysis of data or statistics to uncover meaningful patterns, insights and trends.

questions.stem: Which type of analytics describes what has happened in the past, providing a historical overview?
questions.explanation: Descriptive analytics describes what has happened in the past, for example summarising sales data to understand total revenue for a period.

questions.stem: Investigating a drop in website traffic to determine the reasons behind the decline is an example of which type of analytics?
questions.explanation: Diagnostic analytics focuses on why a particular event or trend occurred by identifying its root causes; the traffic-drop investigation is the given example.

questions.stem: Which type of analytics predicts future outcomes or trends based on historical data and statistical algorithms?
questions.explanation: Predictive analytics predicts future outcomes or trends from historical data and statistical algorithms, such as using machine learning to predict customer churn.

options: Summarises historical revenue for a period
Maps geographic data to find spatial patterns
Identifies the root cause of a past event
Recommends actions to optimise outcomes based on predictive analytics results
questions.explanation: Prescriptive analytics recommends actions to optimise outcomes based on the results of predictive analytics, such as suggesting strategies to increase customer retention.

questions.stem: Analysing customer reviews to understand sentiment and identify common themes is an example of which type of analytics?
questions.explanation: Text analytics, also called text mining, analyses unstructured text data to extract insights, sentiment or patterns.

questions.stem: Mapping crime rates in a city to identify high-crime areas is an example of which type of analytics?
questions.explanation: Spatial analytics analyses geographic or location-based data to uncover spatial patterns and relationships.

questions.stem: Which type of analytics involves tracking page views, bounce rates and click-through rates?
questions.explanation: Web analytics analyses website data to understand user behaviour, track performance and optimise user experience.

questions.stem: Creating dashboards to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) in real time is an example of which type of analytics?
questions.explanation: Business intelligence uses tools and processes to analyse and visualise business data for decision-making, such as KPI dashboards.

questions.stem: Which advancements are said to play a crucial role in predictive and prescriptive analytics?
options: Local area networks and wide area networks
questions.explanation: The evolution of analytics includes machine learning and artificial intelligence, which play a crucial role in predictive and prescriptive analytics.
